business_rules: Cannot tail a sensor that isn't running.
Cursor argument is ignored on this path.
behavior.summary: Look up the sensor id in running_sensors.json. When not found, emit a verdict=error Signal whose remediation directs the agent to /start-sensor.

description: Lifecycle precondition: /tail-sensor requires the sensor to have a registry entry. When no entry exists, the script emits a verdict=error Signal and exits non-zero — the agent must /start-sensor first.

evidence.rationale: Registry lookup branch that errors when no entry exists.

invariants: No envelope Signal is emitted (this is an error path).
expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has one error Signal; exit code is non-zero.

name: Error when no registry entry exists for the sensor id

trigger.summary: Agent invokes /tail-sensor on a sensor id that has never been started in this project.
